body: `fetch` doesn't throw on a 4xx/5xx. If the PMS refuses the release we still answer 204 and the quote shows as cancelled, but the rooms stay blocked in the PMS. Can we check the response and fail the cancel?
nit: typo, `qoute` → `quote`. This message reaches API clients.
This `update` has no `where`, so cancelling one quote cancels every quote in the table. Please add `where id = $1`.

Quote state changes are written straight to `quotes` with no history. Consider adding a `quote_events` table that records every transition (created, confirmed, cancelled) together with who made it, so support can see who cancelled a quote and when.
